propositions: The current workflow fans out 6 separate matrix jobs (5 per-extra + 1 union) consuming 21 concurrent slots on GitHub Free, exceeding the org limit of 20 and causing macOS queuing delays of 6.7-8.4m
The per-extra matrix job set does not match _optional.EXTRAS exactly: mcp is in the matrix but not in EXTRAS, while metrics is in EXTRAS but has no per-extra CI coverage today

A single venv-loop job must replace the matrix fan-out, running isolation iterations over _optional.EXTRAS keys union {mcp} plus one union iteration, each in a fresh venv with explicit rc accumulation to prevent silent failures
The loop must use absolute interpreter paths and never source activate to prevent stacked activations and silent path-based re-testing of earlier extras
infra/github/main-protection.snapshot.json hard-codes removed check names and must be updated to prevent rollback script failures
